# FMI headers

The C headers of the Functional Mock-up Interface 2.0 (`fmi2/`) and 3.0 (`fmi3/`), as published
by the Modelica Association Project "FMI" (https://github.com/modelica/fmi-standard), unchanged.
License: 2-Clause BSD (in the header of each file). Used by `runtime/fmu` (freedyn2 models
exported as Functional Mock-up Units for co-simulation).
